column3: BSB’s “into the wilderness” matches the Textus Receptus; the critical text has “in the wilderness” (ἐρήμῳ).
BSB’s “the devil” and “a high place” reflect the Textus Receptus (διάβολος, ὄρος); the critical text says only “he led Him up.”
“Over all these kingdoms” specifies the Greek “all this authority”; “can give” renders the present “give.”
The Greek explicitly says “before me” in the worship clause.
“Carefully” expresses the force of the compound verb rather than a separate Greek adverb.
“Also” is not explicitly present in the Greek “it has been said.”
“To release the oppressed” renders the more concrete Greek wording “to send the broken in release.”
“Jesus” supplies the unnamed subject; “You did” makes an agent explicit where the Greek says things happened.
The Greek states “three years and six months,” compressed to “three and a half years.”
“Jesus” and “the crowd” make the Greek pronouns explicit.
